The epitope of scFv M0418 was determined by analysis of binding to overlapping peptides spanning the sequence of Bet v 1.0101. Further truncation analysis of peptide ISFPEGFPFKYVKD demonstrated that the optimal epitope was peptide ISFPEGFPFKY. The epitope peptide carried an N-terminal Gly conjugated to biotin and an additional C-terminal Gly residue.

The epitope-specific phage-displayed scFv M0418 bound specifically to Bet v 1, and did not cross-react with Phl p 1, Der p 1, Fel d 1, Mal d 1 or Aln g 1. The epitope-specific scFv M0418 bound to isoforms Bet v 1.0101, Bet v 1.0102, but not to Bet v 1.0112, or the artificial isoforms Bet v 1.2744, and Bet v 1.2595.

Analysis of binding to overlapping peptides spanning the sequence of Bet v 1.0101 demonstrated that epitope-specific scFv M0418 bound to the peptide in a direct ELISA. Furthermore, the peptide inhibited the binding of scFv M0418 to Bet v 1. Alanine scanning of the peptide demonstrated that positions P4, F7, P8 and K10 were the most critical for binding, and positions I1, G6 and Y11 were of intermediate importance. Other modifications that were not tolerated by scFv M0418 were P59S, F62L or F62S, and K65R at positions P4, F7 and K10, respectively. The peptide carried an N-terminal Gly conjugated to biotin and an additional C-terminal Gly residue. The peptide inhibited the binding of epitope-specific scFv M0418 to Bet v 1.
